    How to play
    • It is your birthday. Everyone else is gone. The clown stayed.
    • Reach the green door before dark. Nobody has ever survived the night.
    • He walks while you watch him. He runs when you look away.
    • Find the bat (golden glow). A hit can't hurt him. He only gets dizzy, and for less time with every hit.
    • No bat? Kick. You have to get close, and it only staggers him. If he has the bat, a kick knocks it out of his hands.
    • He has friends. They move when you are not looking. A bat knocks down every one of them in front of you.
    • Then the house: find the key, then open the attic door at the end of the hall. They follow you in.
    • Somewhere there is a party blowout. Pick it up, then blow it (Q): every clown near you stops and covers his ears for a few seconds.
    • Pick up the papers. Somebody was here before you.
    • WASD move, mouse looks, click swings the bat (or kicks without it), F or right-click always kicks, Space jumps, hold Shift to run.
    • Touch: drag on the left to move, drag on the right to look. The big button swings the bat, or kicks when you have none.

    Best with headphones. Birds, cicadas, laughs, screams and hits are public domain and CC0 recordings from Wikimedia Commons. The music box, the drone and the stingers were generated for this game.
